files.title: Image or PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to photos, screenshots, scans (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF) or PDFs, including scanned PDFs.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Languages in the documents. Pick only the ones you need: each extra language slows OCR down a little.

pageSegmentation.title: Layout
pageSegmentation.description: auto suits documents and pages. single-block suits receipts, cards and cropped text. sparse finds scattered text (labels, signs, screenshots).

useTextLayer.title: Use the PDF's own text when it has one
useTextLayer.description: Pages of a digital (non-scanned) PDF are read directly: exact and fast. Turn off to OCR every page.

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only the first pages are read; each page is charged.

pdfDpi.title: PDF render resolution (DPI)
pdfDpi.description: Scanned PDF pages are rendered at this resolution before OCR. 200 suits most scans; 300 helps with small print.

saveTextFiles.title: Save a .txt file per input
saveTextFiles.description: Adds a download link to a plain-text file next to the text in the dataset.

includePages.title: Include per-page text for PDFs
includePages.description: Adds pageTexts: page number, text, confidence and whether it came from OCR or the text layer.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
